summary: Wounds a named arm or leg of an unwounded target within 20'.

effects.subject: target
effects.note: The caster names the limb ([left/right] [arm/leg]) in the Incantation.

clarifications.text: Wounding targets the player but its effect lands on the chosen hit location.
Visibility (line of sight) may be drawn to any part of the target player, not only the chosen hit location.

open_questions: L1 'players already wounded' is read as any existing wound anywhere, not only on the named location.
